title: World Bloom — Link the Beats! — Episode13 Coming Together

meta.Event Outline: VIRTUAL SINGERS in each SEKAI are caring for their respective trees when they are vanished away by a mysterious light. Witnessing this, their counterparts in the space between worlds enter SEKAI to search for them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So yeah, Emu-Emu, Nene-P! It's great to meet the both of you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ooh, “Emu-Emu”!
That's such a cute nickname☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Nene-P...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
I'm so happy about getting to meet a Rin from a different SEKAI! Let's be wonderhoy friends☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, that was super cute!
I wanna try it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Let's be wonderhoy friends☆
Like that?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sh-She's already blending in...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Still, is everything gonna be okay?
Do you know how to get back?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
N-No, I still don't!
What do I do?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, uh... Sorry, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But doesn't that also mean you can hang out with us until you find a way home?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
She's right!
We still have a ton of places to show you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, let's keep having fun until you have to go back☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh...?
How did you guys land on that?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Shouldn't we be helping her find a way back home...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I agree with Luka...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wanna learn more and more about this SEKAI, and I wanna meet everyone else!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I still don't know how I'm gonna get back, but I'll think about that after I finish doing everything else☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, that sounds like a great plan♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A-Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Somehow this Rin seems to fit into this SEKAI better than I do, almost...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Haha.
This me has already made friends with everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
She looks like she's having so much fun...
Which makes me really happy♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
Since we're here, why don't we do a show together?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A show?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! We all put on shows here!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And our goal is to make everyone all around the world smile!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, really?!
But I've never done a show before...
Do you think I can?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, it might be hard for your first time...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But we'll support you as best we can.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We'll start by coming up with a simple story, and you'll be able to perform however you like, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Then, we'll improvise based on what you do.
How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, what?! You guys can do that?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We don't it often... But we should be able to. We do a lot of improv during practices.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Really...?
Then, I wanna give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Woohoo! Alright, what kind of show are we gonna do?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Let's see...
Oh, how about this kind of story?
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Wow! So this is the magic amusement park?! It looks really fun!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “I wanna go on the Ferris wheel and the roller coaster... Oh, but I'm gonna ride the merry-go-round first!”
“No, I don't wanna!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Huh?”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “What?! A-Are you my shadow...?”

rows.Speaker: Girl's Shadow
rows.Line:
“I wanna go on the Ferris wheel!
So...”

rows.Speaker: Girl's Shadow
rows.Line:
“I'm done being your shadow!
I'm gonna go have fun and do what I want♪”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Whaaaat?!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “W-Wait...!”
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Sorceress
rows.Line: “Oh dear... Did you just lose your shadow?”

rows.Speaker: Sorceress
rows.Line:
“That's terrible...
If you don't get it back before the sun goes down...”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “B-Before the sun goes down...?”

rows.Speaker: Sorceress
rows.Line: “You won't be able to go home.”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Huh...? Whaaat?!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Wait! If you don't come back, then I'm gonna be in trouble!”

rows.Speaker: Girl's Shadow
rows.Line: “No way☆ I'm gonna go have lots and lots of fun.”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
“Argh! She's so slippery!
What do I do...?”
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Female Cast Member
rows.Line: “Are you chasing after that shadow?”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Huh? Yeah, but... Who are you?”

rows.Speaker: Female Cast Member
rows.Line: “We're members of this park's cast.”

rows.Speaker: Girl Cast Member
rows.Line: “Our job is to help any guests in need☆”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
“Really?! Then, please help me!
I need to catch my shadow, but she's so slippery...”

rows.Speaker: Girl Cast Member
rows.Line:
“Sure, we'll lend you a hand!
You guys are in, right?”

rows.Speaker: Boy Cast Member
rows.Line: “Yeah, let's catch her together!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Thanks! But how do we actually do that?”

rows.Speaker: Female Cast Member
rows.Line:
“Hehe. That's easy.
Your shadow wants to enjoy herself, yes?”

rows.Speaker: Female Cast Member
rows.Line: “Then we just need to lure her using something fun as bait.”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Oh, right!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Something fun that my shadow won't be able to resist... Hmm... What could that be?”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(Hey, I'm doing pretty well, aren't I?!
Maybe I could even be a real actress?!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (No, I know that the others are giving me a ton of support! Hehe. But this is still really fun.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Anyway, I need to think of what to say next. What would my shadow think of as fun?)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I know...!

rows.Speaker: Girl's Shadow
rows.Line:
“Humhumm♪
What should I do next?”

rows.Speaker: Girl's Shadow
rows.Line: “Since I'm free, I should do all the things I can't do while I'm stuck as her shadow☆”

rows.Speaker: Girl's Shadow
rows.Line: “I've ridden the Ferris wheel, played tag with everyone... Hmm... What else is there...?”
“Wait!”
se_run_women_001_3

rows.Speaker: Girl's Shadow
rows.Line: “Oh...! Are you here to catch me?!”

rows.Speaker: Girl's Shadow
rows.Line:
“But I'm not going back.
I want to be free and keep having fun!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
“Heh heh heh...
If that's the case, then I have something really fun in store for you!”

rows.Speaker: Girl's Shadow
rows.Line: “Huh? What do you mean...?”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “A live performance!”

rows.Speaker: Girl's Shadow
rows.Line: “A live performance?”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Yup! They're the most fun thing in the whole wide world♪ I'll play this guitar, so you try to sing along!”

rows.Speaker: Girl's Shadow
rows.Line: “Wow! That sounds like fun!”

rows.Speaker: Girl Cast Member
rows.Line:
“This melody has a fun skip to it!
Let's sing with them, Sorceress♪”

rows.Speaker: Sorceress
rows.Line: “Hehe. Okay, let's join them.”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Bands really are the best!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (And somehow, this feels so fresh!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (My performance is part of their show, and their show is part of my performance...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (It's like two different SEKAI being connected together!)

rows.Speaker: Boy Cast Member
rows.Line: “Alright, let's dance to their singing!”

rows.Speaker: Female Cast Member
rows.Line: “Hehe. This is so much fun.”

rows.Speaker: Girl's Shadow
rows.Line:
“Phew... We sang and danced so much...
That was a lot of fun.”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Hehe. Do you feel satisfied?”

rows.Speaker: Girl's Shadow
rows.Line:
“Yeah! I really just wanted to do something fun for myself.
I've always just been stuck to you, after all...”

rows.Speaker: Girl's Shadow
rows.Line:
“But I realize something now.
There's nothing more fun than doing stuff with you!”

rows.Speaker: Girl's Shadow
rows.Line: “I had a lot of fun singing and dancing together...♪”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Me too! I'm so glad I got to play with you!”

rows.Speaker: Girl's Shadow
rows.Line: “Then, I guess this counts as us making up☆”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Yeah. Let's do this again sometime!”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Doing a show was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
See what we mean♪
Also, Rin, you put on such a cool performance!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I had a lot of fun singing along.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really?! I'm so glad♪
That was an excellent show!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?
se_walk_men_001_4

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh... Wait, what?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: KAITO?! You're here?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Also, those two that are with you!
Are they the Miku-P and KAITO from this SEKAI?!
This is so cool!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Miku-P? Is that me?
Hehe♪ That's such a cute nickname☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. I see your Rin is cheery and bright, just like ours.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes...
I'm sure they're both very nice girls.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Anyway... Ahem!
Aren't you forgetting someone?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Alright, relax... Rin, this obnoxious person is Tsukasa, and the guy standing next to him is our director, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hello, Rin. It's nice to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, couldn't you have introduced me a little better?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That seemed good enough.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Haha! All of you seem really interesting!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But that boy, Tsukasa... Where have I seen him before?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No, nothing's wrong!
More importantly, KAITO, you gotta hear this!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I just got to do a show with everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I was worried if I'd do well since it was my first time, but it ended up being so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We got to perform as a band and act in a show together... It felt like two different worlds colliding!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Two different worlds...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! And I was in perfect sync with the other Rin...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Which got me thinking, even if we're from different SEKAI, there really is so much we share with each other!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes...
I understand exactly what you mean, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's something we've felt ourselves, recently. There is much to learn from plunging headfirst into a brave new world.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's like, every time we visit someplace new, we get to meet a side of ourselves that we didn't know existed.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And each of those encounters helps us grow...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Let's continue diving into these different worlds, and find new ways to improve ourselves in each one.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's keep doing our best! Wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe♪ Meeting a different me from another SEKAI seems like so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Plus...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That feeling of SEKAI and SEKAI connecting together...was really exciting!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It feels a little strange... But I'm so happy, too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Good for you, “me”!

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: link2_ppr_ed6
